before: Revision.accept(), Revision.reject(), and review item key decisions refuse an incomplete group or a retained row with NotImplemented and no reason in debugInfo.innerError.
after: The same refusal names the skip reason in debugInfo.innerError, such as review.incomplete-group.
reason: The planner refuses the decision before any write and names the skip reason, as before. Only the thrown error changes, so no shared field, operation, snapshot, or protocol message changes.
